conversation.person-erased: Hephaestus cannot reply because your personal data was erased. Contact the instance privacy contact.
conversation.refused.choice-required: Choose which AI may handle your work before you use Hephaestus. You can do that under “Your AI choice” in Hephaestus.
conversation.refused.no-ai: Ask Hephaestus is off for you because you chose No AI. To use Hephaestus, change “Your AI choice” in Hephaestus.
conversation.refused.unavailable: Hephaestus is not set up for your AI choice in this workspace yet. Ask a workspace owner to set it up, or change “Your AI choice” in Hephaestus.
conversation.rejected.follow-ups-full: Hephaestus is still answering. Wait for an answer before you send more messages.
conversation.rejected.not-a-thread-paren: You can reply in a thread only to a message in your conversation with Hephaestus.
conversation.rejected.not-deletable: You can delete only your own messages.
conversation.rejected.not-votable: You can rate only Hephaestus’s messages that are still in your conversation.
conversation.rejected.request-id-reused: This message was already sent somewhere else.
conversation.stage.work: Reading your pull requests and issues…
problem.account-erasure-accepted: We put your account on hold. Your erasure request is still open.
problem.agent-job-state-conflict: The job has changed. Check its current state.
problem.changed-since-shown: This changed since you saw it. Check the new version, then decide again.
problem.check-in-invalid: This check-in cannot work as set. Check the marked field.
problem.concurrent-modification: This changed somewhere else. Check the new version, then try again.
problem.conversation-lease-lost: This attempt can no longer continue.
problem.conversation-rejected: We could not change this conversation.
problem.csrf-token-rejected: Refresh the page and try again.
problem.journal-pending: We accepted the change and are still saving its recovery record. Try again in a moment.
problem.llm-call-pool-in-use: A model still uses this pool.

problem.llm-connection-in-use: A model or assignment still uses this connection.
problem.llm-connection-slug-conflict: Another connection uses this address. Choose a different address.
problem.llm-model-in-use: An assignment still uses this model.

problem.model-assignment-slot-mismatch: Select a model that fits this assignment.
problem.no-model: There is no AI model for this yet. Ask a workspace admin to set one up.
problem.oauth-callback-failed: We could not finish signing you in. Try again.
problem.outline-rate-limited: Outline is limiting requests. Wait, then try again.
problem.outline-unreachable: We could not reach Outline. Try again.
problem.passkey-required: Verify with your passkey to continue.
problem.review-batch-conflict: A review batch is already open. Check its status.
problem.review-schedule-conflict: This conflicts with the current review schedule. Check the schedule and try again.
problem.step-up-required: Sign in again to do this.
problem.sync-not-supported: This connection does not support a manual sync.
problem.turned-off: This feature is off. Check your settings or ask a workspace admin.

problem.workspace-budget-exceeded: The sandbox reached its storage limit.
problem.workspace-owner-required: Give another person the owner role before you continue.
